summary: The evidence gate uses a pull request head's own note only while the branch is at most 24 commits of main behind; a staler branch is judged on its merge tree, so it runs its checks until it is rebased

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. One more condition for the gate's head-tree mode; the decision line gains a behind= field.

compatibility.detail: Required check names and results are unchanged. Collectors that parse the decision line by key see one new key.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; the gate is read from the accepted base, so the revert takes effect for runs after it merges.
